items.title: Accelerate Your Job Search: Why a Portfolio Beats a Resume
items.body: In today’s competitive market, a portfolio showcases your real work, results, and personality—key factors recruiters evaluate over a generic resume. By presenting a curated collection of projects with clear context, you demonstrate problem‑solving, design thinking, and impact. Recruiters can instantly gauge your fit, reducing the interview cycle time and boosting your odds of landing offers. A portfolio also signals professionalism and confidence, qualities that hiring managers value. For professionals across design, copy, coding, and more, a polished portfolio is the fastest path to job offers.
